comment: Expected live status per site, as verified from a residential IP. CI runners use datacenter IPs, so some sites that work locally may be blocked in CI - mark those working:false with a reason so the daily health check only alerts on true regressions. The probe iterates every key here, so all supported sites are listed.

google.reason: Google serves a JS-required interstitial to non-browser clients (verified 2026-08-31); protocol itself unchanged in real browsers

glassdoor.reason: TLS fingerprinting blocks datacenter/non-browser clients; may work with residential proxies

ziprecruiter.reason: TLS fingerprinting blocks datacenter/non-browser clients; US/CA only

naukri.reason: India-focused; untested from CI, historically worked from residential IPs

bdjobs.reason: Bangladesh-focused; untested from CI, selectors may drift
